title: No rule holds a `Core` reference card to the plain voice, and the card sweep handoffs gave goal `plain-comments` was never in its scope.
text: A card is what `nvs help`, a hover and the website print for a member, so an end user reads it. `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads* covers only `.nvs` comments under `docs/examples/`, `tests/hostile/` and `benches/members/`, and `about.md`, and `rule:core-api/reference-card` says nothing about wording. Many proofs goals' handoffs left their classes' older cards to goal `plain-comments`, whose prose says it changes no line of code (`docs/agent/goals/plain-comments.md:12`). Cards in the old voice remain, for example `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/objset.rs:157` ("holds"), `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/objset.rs:185` ("drops") and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs:623` ("drops the remainder"). Closing this either extends `rule:core-api/reference-card` to the plain voice and rewrites the cards, or states in that rule that cards are not held to it.
